title: Small
text: Small. This coffee grinder is very small. It is okay for a single cup pour-over, but isn’t sized for hand grinding enough for a pot of coffee. I was surprised by that, because I typically use an electric grinder every morning for a pot of coffee. I was hoping to replace the electric one with a hand crank version. This is not that solution. It does work. And it looks really cool. But it is the size of a pepper grinder.
